title: Semperis unveils Lightning Platform to accelerate AI identity detection and response
headline: Semperis launches Lightning identity platform for AI and human threats
summary: Semperis has announced the release of Semperis Lightning, a platform designed to provide exposure management, attack-path analysis, and visibility across human, non-human, and agentic AI identities. The launch coincides with Australian organisations managing changing cybersecurity conditions following federal reviews of AI-driven cyber incidents. The platform offers a unified console to monitor identity infrastructures, assess security indicators, and detect suspicious activity across Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta.
why_it_matters: Australian organisations adopting AI agents must ensure visibility and control over non-human and agentic identities to secure critical resources against machine-speed attacks.

quotes.text: Semperis, the identity-driven cyber resilience and crisis response company, today announced the release of Semperis Lightning, a comprehensive identity resilience and security platform designed to help organisations prevent, detect, respond to, and recover from agentic and conventional identity attacks.
With Lightning, organisations can adopt productivity-enhancing AI solutions while reducing risk of AI agents compromising critical resources.

classification.significance_reason: This is a vendor product launch providing identity and security tooling for non-human and agentic AI identities, rather than a binding regulatory change or governance standard.
